description: Servicio de visualización (WMS) del Mapa de movimientos del terreno de España a escala 1:1.000.000 is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by mapas.igme.es. Map showing the geographical distribution of ground movements classified into four main groups: horizontal component in continental areas, vertical component in continental areas, unstable areas linked to coastal areas and movements related to mining operations. Also included are continental areas with important erosive processes. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Service of visualization (WMS) of Ground Movements Map of Spain at scale of 1:1,000,000" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Land Movements, España, Spain, IGME, EGDI, IDEE. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
